summary.text: Marc Greendorfer is the Republican candidate for the Montana House of Representatives, District 59, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
According to Ballotpedia, he is an attorney who was the Republican nominee for Montana House seats in 2022 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: Marc Greendorfer was born in San Francisco, California, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of California, Davis in 1986 and a law degree from Yeshiva University in 1996, according to Ballotpedia.
His career experience includes working as an attorney, and he is the founding partner of Tri Valley Law and the founder of Zachor Legal Institute.
Greendorfer ran as the Republican candidate in Montana House District 62 in 2022 and in District 59 in 2024, losing both general elections to Democratic incumbent Ed Stafman.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a true independent running as a Republican and said he supports small government and personal liberty.
He said his main message is property tax reform, which he proposed to address by capping assessed values at the original purchase price with a capped annual escalation.
